rotating_tips: Message with @name or #group — tap a chat row to focus a target
@bot AssistantName — create a custom bot (opens setup)
@ai your question — PointChat AI in your private notes thread
/location — share position (pick @ or # first, or use focused chat)
Voice notes: ±1s buttons and waveform tap to seek
Type @ to see people and commands
ai_knowledge: PointChat supports DMs (@username), groups (#groupname), voice messages, photos/files, and /location. @bot followed by a name starts creating a custom bot with that name (setup dialog). @ai followed by a message talks to PointChat AI in the user's private self-chat thread. Custom bots reply automatically when messaged. Slash commands: /myprofile, /setting, /location. Users usually need an @ or # target or a focused chat before sending.
